# Configuration

Resolution: `--config PATH` > `MURMUR_CONFIG` > `./murmur.toml` > the packaged defaults, then the API-edited `<data_dir>/settings.toml` over that, then the environment. Every table merges key by key except `[universe.static]`, which a user file replaces wholesale.

## Settings

Editable from the admin page unless marked locked.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `news.max_articles` | integer | 20 | Headlines per ticker per Yahoo fetch. |
| `news.sources` | list (yahoo, finnhub, gdelt) | ["yahoo"] | News sources the daily run queries. finnhub needs an API key; gdelt is paced at one request per 5 s. |
| `prices.source` | choice (yfinance, polygon) | "yfinance" | Daily price source. polygon's free plan cannot serve today's bar at 18:00: set schedule.analysis_time for it. |
| `prices.splits` | choice (auto, polygon, none) | "auto" | Split ratios for return computation (polygon needs its key; auto = polygon when the key is set). Unadjusted sources need them. |
| `sentiment.model` | string | "ProsusAI/finbert" | Hugging Face model id. Changing it re-scores every headline on the next sentiment job. |
| `sentiment.batch_size` | integer | 32 | Headlines per FinBERT batch. |
| `sentiment.device` | choice (cpu, cuda, auto) | "cpu" | cpu, cuda, or auto. The server image is CPU-only. |
| `analysis.keep_ticker_rolling_sessions` | integer | 30 | Sessions of per-company rolling results kept in the store (each month's last session is kept forever; pooled results are never pruned). |
| `sec.contact` | string | "gabebecker2048@gmail.com" | Contact email the SEC requires in the User-Agent. |
| `universe.source` | choice (static, marketcap) | "marketcap" | marketcap builds the monthly top-N; static uses universe.static. |
| `universe.size` | integer | 100 | Coverage: how many ranked companies get news and sentiment (at most index.size). |
| `index.name` | string | "m100" | Dataset and endpoint name of the cap-weighted index (m100 -> Murmur 100). |
| `index.size` | integer | 100 | Companies ranked and weighted each month; coverage is at most this. |
| `index.base_date` | string | "" | Base session of the daily level (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty = the first trading day of the earliest index month on record. |
| `index.base_level` | number | 1000 | The level at the close of the base session. |
| `index.benchmark` | string | "^GSPC" | Yahoo symbol drawn as a comparison line on the index chart (^GSPC = S&P 500). Empty = none. Shown by the API and UI only, never published. |
| `index.benchmark_name` | string | "S&P 500" | The comparison line's label. |
| `universe.min_market_cap` | number | 10000000000 | Screener floor in USD. |
| `universe.static` | table | 50 entries | ticker = name pairs for the static universe. Replaces the list wholesale. |
| `schedule.time` | string | "18:00" | Daily run time, HH:MM in the configured timezone. |
| `schedule.analysis_time` | string | "" | Optional morning slot (HH:MM) running prices + analysis + export for the previous session; schedule.time then only collects news. Empty = one full run. |
| `schedule.paused` | boolean | false | When true the scheduler queues nothing; jobs started by hand still run. |
| `schedule.retries` | integer | 3 | Extra attempts after a failed run. |
| `schedule.retry_delay_minutes` | integer | 20 | Minutes between attempts. |
| `backup.time` | string | "04:30" | Daily store snapshot (HH:MM) into data/backups, uploaded offsite by the murmur-backup service when S3 is configured. Empty = no scheduled snapshot. |
| `backup.keep` | integer | 3 | Snapshots kept on the data volume (older ones are deleted). |
| `backup.prefix` | string | "murmur" | S3 key prefix for the offsite copies (bucket and keys are env only). |
| `backup.max_age_hours` | integer | 30 | The health report flags the offsite copy when the last upload is older. |
| `ui.title` | string | "Murmur" | Dashboard title. |
| `ui.tagline` | string | "Does news predict prices, follow them, or move with them?" | One line under the title. |
| `ui.default_months` | choice (1, 3, 6, 12) | 3 | Rolling horizon the dashboard opens with. |
| `ui.default_method` | choice (pearson, spearman) | "pearson" | Correlation method the dashboard opens with. |
| `ui.theme` | choice (auto, light, dark) | "auto" | Default theme; visitors can switch. |
| `datasets.contact` | string | "" | Contact printed in every license notice (takedown requests); default sec.contact. |
| `datasets.private` | list (companies, prices, news, sentiment, correlations) | [] | Datasets served only with the API token (kept in the manifest, flagged public=false). prices stays here until the source's terms allow publishing. |
| `data_dir` | string | "data" | Data directory (env MURMUR_DATA_DIR). Restart to change. Locked: not editable from the API. |
| `timezone` | string | "America/New_York" | Exchange timezone; the calendar is NYSE regardless. Locked: not editable from the API. |
| `api.host` | string | "0.0.0.0" | Bind address. Locked: not editable from the API. |
| `api.port` | integer | 8100 | Bind port. Locked: not editable from the API. |
| `finnhub.api_key` | secret | "" | Env MURMUR_FINNHUB_API_KEY. Locked: not editable from the API. |
| `polygon.api_key` | secret | "" | Env MURMUR_POLYGON_API_KEY. Locked: not editable from the API. |

Locked keys (file or environment only): `data_dir`, `timezone`, `api.host`, `api.port`, `finnhub.api_key`, `polygon.api_key`.

## Environment

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `MURMUR_CONFIG` | Path of the ops config file. |
| `MURMUR_DATA_DIR` | The data directory (store, published files, settings). |
| `MURMUR_API_TOKEN` | Bearer token for POST/PUT/DELETE; writes are refused without it. |
| `MURMUR_FINNHUB_API_KEY` | Finnhub API key (news source `finnhub`). |
| `MURMUR_POLYGON_API_KEY` | Polygon API key (prices, splits). |
| `MURMUR_CORS_ORIGINS` | Comma-separated origins allowed to call the API from a browser. |
| `MURMUR_LOG_FORMAT` | `json` for one JSON object per log line. |
| `MURMUR_S3_BUCKET`, `MURMUR_S3_REGION`, `MURMUR_S3_ENDPOINT` | The offsite backup target, read by the backup service only (`murmur offsite`). |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | Its credentials (boto3). |
